details.report: Applied and committed all four authorized residual classes in forward commits 411ed56 and 360aa7b. Navigator admission now reconstructs complete byte coverage from successful native sealed evidence-tool results for live and recovered settlements instead of trusting receipt claims. Recovery declarations retain only a bound opaque environment-policy digest plus redacted policy; fresh-process recovery resolves caller-owned policy material, validates the binding, and fails closed when absent or mismatched. Ledger conflict handling now rereads canonical state, returns exact replay, and rejects incompatible active lifecycle winners before child launch. Resume reacquires and compares resolved repository and parent IDs before publication, consultation, or role launch. Added regression coverage for forged evidence claims, repository/parent/both identity drift, concurrent callers, and Navigator/selected-role crash recovery with nondefault environment policy and secret non-persistence. Verification: npm test (375 tests: 370 pass, 5 skipped), npm run typecheck, npm run build:recorder, git diff --check. No authorized exclusions or unadopted findings.
